description: Generates a structured financial report as JSON. Pass either period (one month) or date_from/date_to (a range), never both; invalid or contradictory values are rejected with an error. report_type=pnl: the P&L lines of the period or range as one list ordered by period, without a period argument ALL months (a long history can be large). report_type=category-breakdown: summary figures and category totals. Default is the latest month with data and the output carries one month. For a range of several months it returns months[] (one entry per month, each with summary, categories and category_totals) plus total (the sum of the months with summary re-derived from the summed buckets, not added up from the monthly summaries). report_type=kpi-dashboard: the KPI values with change against the previous month. Default is the latest month with data; for a range of several months it returns months[] with the KPIs of each month, at most 12 months per call (more is rejected). category-breakdown and kpi-dashboard answer with an error naming the available data range when the period or range has no data; in a multi-month range, months without data are listed in missing_periods.

date_from.description: Start of a range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Optional on its own: the range then starts at the first month with data. Not allowed together with period.

date_to.description: End of a range (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Optional on its own: the range then ends at the last month with data. Not allowed together with period; must not be before date_from.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

period.description: One month (YYYY-MM). Use either period or date_from/date_to, not both. Without any time argument: pnl returns all months, category-breakdown and kpi-dashboard the latest month with data.

name: export-report
